Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2768; something horned, i.e. (specially) the pod of the carob-tree:--husk.
BiblicalUsage: Keration means a husk, the pod of the carob tree. Luke 15:16 says the prodigal would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat, and no man gave unto him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe husks are what sin leaves you hungry for, and no man can give you what only the Father's house has.
